title: Part 1: Mô tả hình ảnh (Photographs)
description: Nghe một mô tả ngắn về một bức tranh và chọn câu mô tả đúng nhất. 6 câu hỏi.

items.audio: The woman is sitting at a desk and typing on a computer.
items.transcript: The woman is sitting at a desk and typing on a computer.
options: A woman is cooking in the kitchen.
A woman is working at a computer.
A man is reading a newspaper.
People are having a meeting.
items.explanation: Câu mô tả "The woman is sitting at a desk and typing on a computer" = Một phụ nữ đang làm việc trên máy tính.

items.audio: Several people are waiting in line at a bus stop.
items.transcript: Several people are waiting in line at a bus stop.
options: People are boarding a train.
People are shopping at a store.
People are waiting at a bus stop.
People are walking in a park.
items.explanation: "Waiting in line at a bus stop" = Đang xếp hàng ở trạm xe buýt.

items.audio: A man is delivering a package to a woman at the door.
items.transcript: A man is delivering a package to a woman at the door.
options: A man is cleaning the house.
A woman is opening a window.
A man is delivering a package.
A woman is mailing a letter.
items.explanation: "Delivering a package to a woman at the door" = Giao gói hàng cho phụ nữ tại cửa.

items.audio: The conference room is filled with people listening to a presentation.
items.transcript: The conference room is filled with people listening to a presentation.
options: People are eating lunch.
People are listening to a presentation.
People are playing games.
The room is empty.
items.explanation: "Conference room filled with people listening to a presentation" = Phòng họp có người đang nghe thuyết trình.

items.audio: A construction worker is examining a blueprint outside a building.
items.transcript: A construction worker is examining a blueprint outside a building.
options: A worker is fixing a pipe.
A worker is examining a blueprint.
A worker is painting a wall.
A worker is driving a truck.
items.explanation: "Examining a blueprint" = Đang kiểm tra bản thiết kế.

items.audio: Two people are shaking hands across a table in an office.
items.transcript: Two people are shaking hands across a table in an office.
options: People are fighting.
People are eating dinner.
People are shaking hands.
People are signing a contract.
items.explanation: "Shaking hands across a table" = Bắt tay qua bàn.
